skill.name: critique
skill.description: Evaluate design effectiveness from a UX perspective. Assesses visual hierarchy, information architecture, emotional resonance, and overall design quality with actionable feedback.
skill.summary: Design critique for UX quality, visual hierarchy, and actionable interface improvements.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive. The flagged line is a design critique test about perceived AI-generated visual quality, not system reconnaissance or environment inspection.

static_findings.snippet: **The test**: If you showed this to someone and said "AI made this," would they believe you immediat

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 asks whether a design looks AI-generated to a viewer. It does not request host, system, network, or environment reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Design teams need direct feedback that separates polish from real user impact. This skill reviews hierarchy, structure, tone, and patterns with practical fixes.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates whether an interface looks generic or AI-generated.
Reviews visual hierarchy, primary actions, and competing elements.
Assesses information architecture, navigation clarity, and content grouping.
Checks emotional tone, brand fit, and user trust signals.
Reviews states, microcopy, affordance, typography, and color use.
Produces prioritized design issues with concrete fixes.
limitations: Requires a visible interface, screenshot, mockup, or clear product description.
Does not run usability studies or collect user behavior data.
Cannot verify implementation quality without access to the product or code.
May need brand goals and audience details for precise tone feedback.

use_cases.title: Review a new product screen
use_cases.description: Identify hierarchy, copy, and layout issues before a feature reaches customers.

use_cases.title: Improve generated UI work
use_cases.description: Find visual patterns that make an interface feel generic or AI-generated.

use_cases.title: Prepare design feedback
use_cases.description: Create direct critique notes for product reviews, design reviews, or stakeholder discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Quick screen critique
prompt_templates.prompt: Critique this screen from a UX and visual design perspective. Focus on the biggest issue and the clearest fix.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize launch fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this interface for launch readiness. List the top five design issues in priority order with concrete fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Assess brand fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Critique this design for visual hierarchy, emotional tone, brand fit, and user trust. Explain what feels intentional or weak.

prompt_templates.title: Run a detailed design audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full critique across hierarchy, architecture, affordance, composition, typography, color, states, and microcopy. Include direct remediation steps.

output_examples.input: A dashboard screenshot with many cards, equal button weights, and muted labels.
output_examples.output: The primary action is hard to find because every card has similar weight. Increase contrast for the main action and reduce secondary controls.

output_examples.input: A landing page mockup with gradient text, glass panels, and repeated metric cards.
output_examples.output: The page reads as generic AI-generated design. Replace decorative effects with product-specific imagery, clearer hierarchy, and sharper proof points.

output_examples.input: A settings page with unclear labels and no saved state feedback.
output_examples.output: The form lacks confidence cues. Rewrite labels around user intent and add visible saving, success, and error states.

best_practices: Provide screenshots, mockups, or a clear description of the current interface.
Include the target audience, product goal, and brand attributes.
Ask for prioritized fixes when time or scope is limited.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without showing the interface or describing the design.
Asking only for praise instead of specific problems and tradeoffs.
Ignoring product goals, user context, and brand direction.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews UX quality, visual hierarchy, layout, copy, tone, states, and design patterns.

faq.question: Can it critique screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. A screenshot or mockup gives the skill enough context for practical feedback.

faq.question: Does it replace user research?
faq.answer: No. It provides expert design critique, but it does not measure real user behavior.

faq.question: Can developers use it?
faq.answer: Yes. Developers can use it to improve frontend work before design or product review.

faq.question: Does it focus only on visual polish?
faq.answer: No. It also checks information architecture, affordance, states, microcopy, and user impact.

faq.question: How should I get the best results?
faq.answer: Share the interface, the audience, the product goal, and any brand constraints.
